title: Honky Tonk Women

why: **Open G**: one-finger major chords and the Keith-style I → IV/I “sus” grab against open strings.
hard_change: **Sliding the barre 5 → 7 (C → D)** cleanly at the turnaround.
theory: I–IV–I with G7 (F natural = Mixolydian); A = V/V → D (V). Chorus I–IV6/4.
steps: Retune to open G (D G D G B D) and take off or ignore the 6th string. Changes alone, slowly.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 83 bpm), stabs with the C/G grab.
tips: G7 (x00003) is not from the sources — it is the obvious open-G grip for the I7 bar.
caveat: Tuning, key and chords agree across sources; the bar-by-bar verse layout is reconstructed — check it against the record.
